title: The Internet didn’t break; we just forgot what it was leaning on
description: Guest Post: When international links fail, hidden dependencies can take local services with them. Here’s how operators can design for local resilience.

title: Registrars Must Offer DNSSEC, but Fewer Than One in Ten Use It Themselves
description: A study of 698 ICANN-accredited registrar domains finds just 9.46% have DNSSEC enabled, with European registrars leading adoption. Regional differences remain significant after accounting for registrar size, raising questions about security practices.

title: Africa Youth IGF: Political Leaders Must Listen, Not Just Speak

title: APT36 Deploys Multiple Malware in RapidRust: A DNS Investigation
description: An investigation of APT36's RapidRust campaign identified malicious infrastructure linked to four malware variants, uncovering 341 email-connected domains, two malicious IP addresses, and 53 domains sharing naming patterns with known indicators.

title: See the agents, set the terms: new visibility and control for personal agents
description: Personal AI agents have changed how users interact with the web, blurring the lines between automated and human traffic. Learn how Cloudflare gives site owners visibility and control to manage personal agent access.

title: The RIPE Chair Team Reports - Highlights from RIPE 93
description: From digital independence and practical AI to inclusion and research, RIPE 93 gave the community plenty to discuss and act on. The RIPE Chair Team shares personal highlights from Sofia and ways to get involved in the work ahead.

title: Solar PV for Internet resilience (Part 1): Designing your system
description: Guest Post: Solar photovoltaics and battery storage can provide reliable power for network infrastructure, even in remote locations. Here’s what’s good to know before selecting equipment.

title: Shopify Filing Points to $99 Million Price for Shop.com Domain Acquisition
description: Shopify's financial filing reveals a $99 million expenditure linked to its Shop.com acquisition, potentially exceeding the previous domain sale record of $70 million, although the company has not separately confirmed the domain's purchase price.

description: A study of approximately 40 million domain names across 10 ccTLDs identifies domain age and registrant location as key renewal factors, highlighting the importance of retention strategies tailored to individual registry markets.

title: Who Tells the Time? Measuring NTP Exposure Across Publicly Routed IPv4 Prefixes

title: Restating the case for DNSSEC
